clips.title: The story
paras: At Tiragarde Keep, Kul Tiran forces hold a coastal foothold in Durotar. Gar'Thok has ordered a Horde strike against Lieutenant Benedict's garrison, whose presence breaks the fragile peace with Theramore.

Thrall led the Horde across the Great Sea to Kalimdor, where he joined Lady Jaina Proudmoore against the Burning Legion at Mount Hyjal. Peace broke when Jaina's estranged father, Grand Admiral Daelin Proudmoore, brought Kul Tiras's navy to Durotar. He blamed all orcs for the Old Horde's atrocities and seized coastal footholds, including Tiragarde Keep. Daelin died at Theramore, but remnants of his fleet still refuse any pact or surrender their hatred.

Tiragarde Keep fell briefly after the Grand Admiral's defeat, then Kul Tiras reserves under Lieutenant Benedict retook it. The fortress lies between Razor Hill and Sen'jin Village. From there, sailors and marines harass travelers and threaten Durotar's eastern sea approaches. Gar'Thok sees their position as an immediate danger to Durotar's security and calls on Horde warriors to strike at Benedict's command.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Led by Admiral Proudmoore, the humans of Kul Tiras encroached on Durotar, violating the Warchief's pact made with Jaina Proudmoore in order to defeat Archimonde years ago.

The human aggression was repelled and Tiragarde Keep fell. But recently, the Admiral's reserves, led by Lieutenant Benedict, have retaken the keep and once again pose a threat to our homeland. These humans show no respect for diplomacy.
Prove your honor and travel south to Tiragarde Keep to eliminate the human invaders.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You have your orders, friend. The safety of Durotar is in question. Complete the task before you or hang your head in shame.
Show your honor and defeat the humans of Tiragarde Keep.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Word of your bravery travels fast, warrior. Tales of your victory at Tiragarde Keep will be heralded in Orgrimmar.
